scope: ExecutionAdapter and CaseObserver ports with explicit application-owned registrations
Framework-neutral strict Sandbox transport and migrated built-in PytestAdapter
Pinned adapter implementation/configuration at Check admission and runtime binding at verification
Detached Worker reconstruction, per-session isolation and completion binding records

verification.sandbox_unit_skip_reason: Windows-specific checks on a Linux host

corrected_during_validation: A restart initially treated omitted versus explicit constructor defaults as different configurations. Factory signature defaults are now normalized, with a regression test.

source.manifest_rule: SHA-256 each src/**/*.py and tests/**/*.py plus extra_paths, indexed by relative path; SHA-256 the sorted-key compact JSON mapping.

limitations: Pytest is still the only bundled production framework adapter. The second adapter is a controlled test fixture.
Custom registrations are injected by an application through the Python Harness constructor; the stock CLI uses built-in registration.
Plugins are trusted application code, not sandboxed untrusted Python extensions. Same-user tamper resistance is not claimed.
No model calls, commercial-model quality comparison or Windows-native validation were performed.
Reports remain unsigned local-advisory records, not goal-completeness or Ready certification.
